{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep only the row with highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Filter to treatment arm only
treatment_only = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute response fraction
n_treatment = len(treatment_only)
n_responded = treatment_only['responded'].sum()
fraction_responded = n_responded / n_treatment

print(f"Number of patients in treatment arm (deduplicated): {n_treatment}")
print(f"Number who responded: {n_responded}")
print(f"Fraction responded: {fraction_responded}")

# Return the fraction
fraction_responded"}
